title: Freaky Friday
about: A mother and daughter swap bodies after a fortune cookie curse, the day before the mum's wedding.

    StartersChinese restaurant spring rollsFried rolls of pork mince, wombok, carrot and rice vermicelliHow to make it50g rice vermicelli300g pork mince300g wombok, shredded2 carrots, grated12 spring rolls of pastry sheets1 L vegetable oil, for frying120ml sweet chilli sauceSoak the vermicelli until soft, drain and chop.Shred the wombok and grate the carrots.Cook the pork mince until browned.Mix the pork with the vermicelli and vegetables and cool.Roll tightly in the spring roll pastry.Fry at 180°C in batches until crisp and blistered.Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce.Garage rehearsal popcorn chickenBite size chicken thigh coated in panko and paprika, shallow friedHow to make it600g chicken thigh fillets2 eggs, beaten1 cup plain flour1 cup panko breadcrumbs1 tsp sweet paprika1 tsp salt500ml vegetable oil, for frying3 tbsp honey mustardCut the chicken into bite-size pieces.Mix the flour, panko, paprika and salt. Dip the chicken in egg, then in the crumb mix.Shallow fry in the vegetable oil in batches until golden.Drain and serve with honey mustard.Rehearsal dinner salmon blinis and melonThe wedding rehearsal dinnerHow to make itAs written, serves 4Blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and chives, beside wedges of rockmelon wrapped in thin prosciutto, on silver trays.Warm 24 mocktail blinis at 180°C for 4 minutes.Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of half a lemon and a pinch of salt.Top each blini with a spoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon from 150g and a few snipped chives.Cut half a rockmelon into 12 thin wedges, remove the skin and wrap each in a slice of prosciutto from 100g.Arrange both on a silver tray with lemon wedges.MainsHoney chickenCrispy chicken thigh tossed in a honey and soy glaze, with sesameHow to make it800g chicken thighs, in pieces1/2 cup cornflour500ml vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp sesame seeds300g jasmine riceCut the chicken and toss in cornflour.Cook the jasmine rice.Fry the chicken in the vegetable oil in batches until crisp.Warm the honey with the soy sauce until bubbling and toss the chicken through.Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over the rice.Pei-Pei's family black pepper beefDinner at Pei-Pei's family restaurant, fortunes to followHow to make it600g rump steak, thinly sliced2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp cornflour3 tbsp oyster sauce2 tsp black pepper, coarsely cracked1 tsp sugar2 tbsp vegetable oil1 brown onion, cut in wedges1 green capsicum, cut in squares3 garlic cloves, sliced1 bunch gai lan, cut in lengths300g jasmine riceToss the beef with half the soy sauce and the cornflour and leave it while you prep.Mix the oyster sauce, the rest of the soy, the pepper, sugar and 3 tbsp water.Rinse the rice and simmer it, covered, until the water is gone. Rest it with the lid on.Stir-fry the beef in a very hot wok with half the oil in two batches until browned. Lift out.Stir-fry the onion, capsicum, garlic and gai lan in the rest of the oil, return the beef, add the sauce and toss until glossy. Serve over the rice.SweetsHomemade fortune cookiesThin vanilla cookies folded into the classic fortune shapeHow to make it2 egg whites80g caster sugar60g plain flour30g butter, melted1/2 tsp vanilla extract12 paper fortunesWhisk the egg whites with the sugar, then mix in the flour, butter and vanilla.Spread thin rounds on a lined tray.Bake until the edges are golden, in batches.Working quickly while hot, lay a fortune on each, fold and bend over a cup.Cool until crisp.DrinksLychee jasmine iced tea with limeJasmine tea chilled with lychees, lychee syrup and limeHow to make it4 jasmine tea bags800ml hot water (about 85C)565g tin lychees2 limes200ml soda water4 cups iceSteep the tea bags in the hot water, then remove.Chill the tea.Drain the lychees, keeping the syrup.Mix the cold tea with some of the lychee syrup and the juice of a lime.Fill glasses with ice and lychees, pour over the tea and top with soda water and a lime wheel.Mango smoothieFuel for Pink Slip's House of Blues audition.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
